6.29 rsInvalidTextEffect
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidTextEffect is a critical error that will occur when the Style.TextEffect element is set to a
constant String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is not one of its valid values.
